text:
Maya R: Handoff — I'm stepping off at 07:00 UTC. Quick capacity + quota notes for the night:
- alpha pool: 48 GPUs (38 used, 79%). 15m avg ~76%, 95th spikes to ~92% during short bursts.
- Scheduled job: Lexicor large eval at ~03:00 UTC (03:00–03:25 window). Estimated extra ~4–7 GPUs for ~20m depending on beam width.
- Reserved: AtlasCorp has 10 reserved GPUs (do NOT preempt).
- Canary: redwood-compact-v2 has been using ~7% more memory on warmups — watch for OOMs on shards 3/4.
- Burst headroom: currently ~2 free GPUs before we hit burst cap; autoscale only kicks at 85% sustained.
If you want to pre-provision headroom, we should temporarily bump min-capacity on alpha by +4.
Useful checks:
```
rictl pool metrics alpha --window 15m
rictl jobs list --filter lexicor --since 2h
redwoodctl quotas get --customer AtlasCorp
```
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-capacity (see "Scheduled evals" section). I'll keep pager for first 30m after handoff.
Maya

Ashwin P: Thanks Maya — heads up noted. Quick Q: can we lower autoscale threshold to 75% temporarily or do we want to just bump min-capacity? Lowering threshold might cause noisy scale events.

Jamie L: I can cover overnight 00:00–04:30 UTC if someone needs a swap. Happy to bump min-capacity by +4 and monitor for 1hr. :thumbsup:

Maya R: @Jamie L awesome, please do bump min-capacity to +4 and revert after 04:00 if stable. I left the exact command in the runbook but it's:
```
rictl pool update alpha --min-gpus +4 --reason "temporary headroom for scheduled Lexicor eval"
```

Samir K: oncall-bot just pushed a scheduled-job alert for Lexicor 02:58 UTC -> 03:26 UTC (looks like small reschedule). (oncall-bot: scheduled-job id=job-9821).

oncall-bot: Scheduled job warning: job-9821 (lexicor-eval) planned start 02:58 UTC, predicted peak GPUs: 6, predicted peak mem per-GPU: 42GB.

Olivia Z: FYI — if we need fine-grained customer throttles, we can set a per-customer soft quota. Quick command:
```
redwoodctl quotas update --customer lexicor --max-gpus 4 --policy soft-throttle
```
That will hold them to 4 GPUs and let other jobs burst. Only do if we see AtlasCorp impacted.

Ashwin P: Good call @Olivia Z. Let's hold off unless AtlasCorp latency increases. Action items: (1) @Jamie L bump +4 now; (2) watch alpha metrics, especially shards 3/4 for OOMs; (3) if AtlasCorp latency >2s, apply soft throttle to lexicor.

Jamie L: Doing the bump now.
```
> rictl pool update alpha --min-gpus +4 --reason "night headroom for lexicor eval"
Applied. New min: 12 -> 16 (expected extra allocation within 90s).
```

Jamie L: Seeing new nodes starting, alpha free GPUs bumped to 6. Monitoring. :eyes:

Maya R: Thank you — appreciate the cover. If anything odd, ping @Samir K and tag oncall channel. I'm signing off.

Samir K: I'll keep an eye on canary shard logs. If any OOMs or job rejects, I'll escalate.

Olivia Z: If we do throttle, remember to add note in account audit with reason and revert after window.

Jamie L: 03:12 UTC update — lexicor reached peak ~5 GPUs, memory within expected, no OOMs. 95th latency for AtlasCorp unchanged. Holding until 03:40 then will start scale-down.

oncall-bot: Pool alpha autoscale event: scaled up +5 GPUs at 03:11 UTC (trigger threshold 75% sustained for 2m).

Jamie L: Scaling down now, freeing 4 GPUs. All stable.

Maya R: Logged — thanks team.
